name: Random number generator
title: Random Number Generator: Pick Numbers in Any Range
description: Pick a random number between any two numbers, or draw several at once with no repeats, sorted or with decimals. Fair, instant and private.
summary: Random numbers in any range, one or many, with or without repeats.
howTo: Enter the lowest and highest number. Both are included, so 1 to 10 can give 1 or 10.
Set how many numbers to draw. Tick No repeats for a raffle or a lottery-style draw, and Sort to list them in order.
Press Generate or Enter. Copy the result, or press again for a new draw; earlier draws stay listed below.

faq.a: They come from your browser’s cryptographic random number generator, and the tool avoids the rounding shortcut that makes some numbers slightly more likely than others. Every number in the range has exactly the same chance.
Yes. Both ends count, so a draw from 1 to 6 works exactly like a die.

faq.q: Can I use it for a raffle or a giveaway?
faq.a: Yes. Number your entries, set the range to match and tick No repeats, then draw as many winners as you need. For a list of names, the spin the wheel tool does this directly.

faq.q: Can it pick decimals or negative numbers?
faq.a: Yes. Choose up to four decimal places, and use negative numbers for either end of the range.
